# Mnemio

> Mnemio is a flashcard and spaced-repetition (SRS) learning web app. Users build decks
> of cards, study them with an SRS scheduler that times reviews for long-term retention,
> discover and copy public decks, track learning stats, and generate cards with AI.

Mnemio is built for learners who want to remember what they study — languages, science,
history, exam prep, and more — using active recall and spaced repetition rather than
passive re-reading or cramming.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://mnemio.xyz/): product overview, features, and FAQ.
- [Discover decks](https://mnemio.xyz/discover): browse and search thousands of free,
  public flashcard decks and study sets across many subjects and languages.
- [About](https://mnemio.xyz/about): the product's mission and how it works.
- [Pricing](https://mnemio.xyz/pricing): Free plan and Mnemio Premium ($10/month, or
  $8/month billed annually).
- [Blog](https://mnemio.xyz/blog): articles on spaced repetition, active recall, and
  effective study technique.

## Concepts

- Spaced repetition: reviewing material at increasing intervals so it transfers to
  long-term memory with minimal total study time.
- Active recall: retrieving an answer from memory (the core of a flashcard) is far more
  effective for retention than re-reading.
- SRS scheduler: Mnemio rates each review and schedules the next one based on how well
  the card was recalled.
